subject: Tenant geofence closure confirmation and ops runbook
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@pillarfin.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Pillar Financial SOC <soc@pillarfin.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant geofence closure: confirmation & evidence request

Hi Ben,

We are beginning a controlled shutdown (closure) of a test tenant in our staging fleet and need formal confirmation from Redwood on a few points before we proceed:

1) Region pin: confirm the tenant will be pinned to the US-West region (no cross-region replication for active data).
2) Isolation: describe the exact isolation boundary (network, storage, and process-level) and whether other tenants share any persistent volumes.
3) Snapshots/backups: what automated snapshots exist, how long are they retained, and what is the process to ensure no snapshot persists after a requested deletion?
4) Erasure proof: we need a runbook and at least one sample artifact (audit-friendly) we can reference for compliance.

Can you send a short ops runbook and an outline of artifacts we should expect (logs, snapshot IDs, SAN wipe confirmation, etc.)? Our security team (cc'd) would like to review and approve before we sign-off on the closure the week of Nov 16.

Thanks,
Sara Li
Security Program Manager
Pillar Financial
[sara.li@pillarfin.com]

[Attachment: audit_requirements_pillar.pdf (pdf) referenced]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@pillarfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant geofence closure: confirmation & evidence request

Sara — thanks for the clear list. I put together an initial ops runbook and included the core artifacts we can provide. See the summary below and the attached draft runbook.

Quick answers up-front:
- Region pin: the tenant is pinned to US-West (zone us-west-2a/2b) at the fabric level; no active cross-region replication is performed for tenant data unless explicitly enabled by a config flag.
- Isolation: tenants are isolated at VM/process level and use tenant-scoped volumes. Persistent storage for dedicated deployments uses single-tenant LUNs attached to the GPU host; other tenants will not share the same LUN. Network ACLs and VPC routing ensure control-plane and customer control-plane components are segmented.
- Snapshots/backups: automatic snapshots are taken for backups every 24 hours with a 7-day retention default for dedicated staging tenants. For a closure, we schedule a snapshot purge job and run a verification sweep to delete snapshot references and enumerate any object-store copies.

Planned deliverables for Pillar:
1) "tenant_wipe_runbook_v1.pdf" (attached) — step-by-step with commands, ticket IDs, expected timelines.
2) "network_topology_zone-map.png" (attached) — shows isolation boundaries.
3) "snapshot_retention_matrix.xlsx" — retention windows and toggle points.
4) Audit artifact: post-wipe evidence bundle (logs + snapshot IDs + scrub report) delivered within 48 hours of completion.

Next steps: if that list looks good, I'll route to Ops for scheduling the wipe and set up a DocuSign acceptance for the planned MOP (maintenance order procedure). Laura and Rishi — can you confirm the 48-hour evidence SLA and whether we should include an escrow snapshot option for Pillar?

Best,
Ben Carter

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant geofence closure: confirmation & evidence request

Ben — I reviewed the runbook. A couple of clarifying Qs for the compliance packet:

- Retention window: you noted 7-day retention for staging tenants by default. For Pillar's closure I recommend we set retention to zero for snapshots prior to running the purge job to minimize the window; confirm we can programmatically override retention per-tenant immediately.
- Object-store copies: we need a deterministic listing of any object-store buckets/paths that may contain redudant copies and a TTL wipe on the final artifact. Please include the exact bucket names in the evidence bundle.
- RPO/RTO impact: confirm whether snapshot purge will affect any warm caches or inference logs we must export for their records.

I'll add a one-page checklist to the runbook for the SOC reviewer to tick off.

Laura Bennett
Head of Dedicated Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant geofence closure: confirmation & evidence request

Thanks — quick operational notes:

- We can override snapshot retention per-tenant immediately; ops-side script will set retention to 0 and then queue the purge job. I confirm the evidence SLA: 48 hours post-completion for the bundle (scrub logs, snapshot IDs, object-store delete receipts).
- Escrow snapshot option: we can offer a single immutable export (WORM snapshot) for escrow with customer-managed encryption; stored for a 30-day escrow window and then destroyed if Pillar does not request retrieval. That can be a billable add-on.
- Impact to caches/logs: purge will not delete short-term inference caches (ephemeral) but will remove persistent logs beyond the last 7 days unless we export them first. Recommend export of the last 14 days of inference logs in CSV as part of the evidence bundle if Pillar requests.

Stephanie — can you attach the runbook checklist and the ticket template we use for the purge so Ben can send to Pillar?

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product Operations
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant geofence closure: confirmation & evidence request

Sara — attaching the consolidated plan and next steps below. Once you confirm acceptance we'll create the MOP and a DocuSign for sign-off.

Summary of the agreed plan for Pillar Financial (staging tenant):
1) Region pinning: tenant will remain pinned to US-West (us-west-2). No cross-region replication configured.
2) Retention override: we will set snapshot retention to 0 immediately prior to purge.
3) Purge job: automated snapshot purge followed by object-store sweep (we enumerate and delete any bucket copies).
4) Evidence delivery: 48 hours after completion we will deliver the evidence bundle containing: deleted snapshot IDs, object-store delete receipts, scrub logs, and a signed operator checklist.
5) Escrow option: optional WORM snapshot export (customer-managed key) held for 30 days for an additional fee; let us know if you want to enable that.
6) Timeline: schedule the purge window during the Nov 16–20 maintenance window you proposed. Actual wipe takes ~2–4 hours; evidence bundle will follow in 48 hours.

Attachments enclosed: tenant_wipe_runbook_v1.pdf, network_topology_zone-map.png, snapshot_retention_matrix.xlsx, signed_mop_docusign_link.txt (DocuSign link to the MOP).

Please reply with:
- "ACCEPT" to proceed as-is and receive the DocuSign MOP, or
- "REQUEST ESCROW" if you'd like the escrow snapshot option enabled.

Thanks — I can set the DocuSign for signature as soon as I get your acceptance.
